tasks.label: Git: Commit All Changes
tasks.command: git rm -r --cached src/OrderShieldPro.API/bin src/OrderShieldPro.API/obj src/OrderShieldPro.Application/bin src/OrderShieldPro.Application/obj src/OrderShieldPro.Domain/bin src/OrderShieldPro.Domain/obj src/OrderShieldPro.Infrastructure/bin src/OrderShieldPro.Infrastructure/obj src/OrderShieldPro.Tests/bin src/OrderShieldPro.Tests/obj ordershieldpro-web/dist ordershieldpro-web/.angular src/OrderShieldPro.API/uploads 2>$null; git add -A; git commit -m '${input:commitMessage}'; Write-Host '--- Commit complete ---'

tasks.label: Kill All: Free Ports (5017 + 4300)
tasks.command: Write-Host '--- Killing Backend (port 5017) ---'; $pids5017 = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5017 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique; if ($pids5017) { $pids5017 | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "Killed PID $_" } } else { Write-Host 'No process on port 5017' }; Write-Host '--- Killing Frontend (port 4300) ---'; $pids4300 = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4300 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique; if ($pids4300) { $pids4300 | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "Killed PID $_" } } else { Write-Host 'No process on port 4300' }; Write-Host '--- Done: Ports 5017 and 4300 are free ---'
